summary: Wrapped the synopsis toggle IIFE in a document.fonts.ready guard: 'var fontsReady = (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve(); fontsReady.then(function () { ... });'. Falls back to Promise.resolve() when document.fonts is unavailable (jsdom/older browsers).
Added a 4-line inline comment above the synopsis rendering IIFE documenting the project_summary (plain text) vs extractSynopsis() (Markdown) rendering asymmetry.
Added font-family: inherit to the .plan-synopsis__toggle CSS rule to prevent button font inheritance issues.

All 3436 tests pass. Discovered and resolved jsdom incompatibility: document.fonts is undefined in jsdom 29.0.0, requiring the defensive guard to prevent TypeError propagation in the test Promise chain.

comments.note: project-detail.js: The guard pattern 'var fontsReady = (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()' is now duplicated in one place, but if additional deferral points are ever needed (e.g. outcome-synopsis toggle), they should reuse this same guard pattern rather than inline document.fonts.ready directly.
The ES5 compatibility constraint (no const/let/arrow functions) is enforced correctly — the guard and .then() use var and function() syntax throughout.
